evidence_class: Ran: source/archive/build custody and no-run/source-quality commands. Static: partial instrumentation review. No physical invocation or numerical inequality reconstruction.

missing_facts.W1: Actual naturally reached p0/correction/p1/norm/radius operand stream and exact signed/ULP/exact-real inequality; potential hooks do not replace capture.
missing_facts.W2: Actual p2[5]/scaled_lower[5], corrections, maps and ordered inequality; no actual bit stream collected.
missing_facts.W3: Comprehensive actual derivative/caller roles and terminal error provenance plus captured M/H/T bits; no phase inference after failed construction.
missing_facts.readiness: Complete reviewed hook/field schema, defensible output bound, successful focused formatting/no-new-lint comparison and approved sealed receipt.
missing_facts.runtime: No completed day or credible native work/cost model against adopted targets; no cost reduction supplied by observation.

follow_on: No repair, solver replacement, new capture or expanded allowance is implied by preservation.
